adds.title: Legislative Assembly of Goiás bill - 24 August 2022
adds.summary: On 24 August 2022 the Legislative Assembly of Goiás approved a bill prohibiting 'gender ideology' in schools in Goiás.

adds.title: Supreme Federal Court ruling - 1 March 2018 on name and sex change
adds.summary: On 1 March 2018 in ADI 4275 the Plenary of the Supreme Federal Court held that the right to equality without discrimination encompasses gender identity/expression as a manifestation of personality that the State must recognize and therefore permitted alteration of name and gender in the civil registry without sex-reassignment surgery or judicial authorization.

adds.title: Supreme Federal Court ruling of 1 March 2018
adds.summary: On 1 March 2018 in ADI 4275 the STF held that equality without discrimination encompasses gender identity and expression and that trans persons may change name and gender on the civil registry without sex-reassignment surgery or judicial authorization because gender identity is a manifestation of personality that the State must recognize.

adds.title: Cuiabá municipal law banning trans athletes - Official Gazette publication 15 September 2025
adds.summary: On 15 September 2025 the mayor of Cuiabá, Mato Grosso sanctioned a municipal law prohibiting trans athletes from competing in women's competitions.
